## Bicycle Health - Mid-Level Full Stack Software Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/bicyclehealth/jobs/6144451004)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Full Stack Engineer building web and mobile telehealth applications for Bicycle Health’s opioid-use-disorder treatment platform. Developing secure patient-care features across React, Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and cloud services.
Full Stack Engineer building telehealth applications for Bicycle Health’s opioid-use-disorder care platform
- Salary: $120,000 - $160,000 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, GraphQL, JavaScript, Node.js, React, TypeScript
- Implement, test, and maintain critical product features using TypeScript, React, GraphQL, and Node.js
- Partner with product managers, physicians, and staff members to build solutions that improve the patient experience
- Build and maintain features across mobile applications, TypeScript backend services, and cloud-based data layers
- Ensure end-to-end functionality and performance
- Deliver reliable and transparent value to users while maintaining high standards for code quality and performance
- Embrace Lean Startup behaviors to simplify technology and processes
- Build relationships with teammates and stakeholders
- Participate in code reviews and shared learning sessions
- 3-5 years of professional experience building and maintaining web or mobile-responsive applications and backend services
- Proficiency with React and Node.js
- Strong experience with TypeScript is highly preferred
- Experience working with GraphQL or Express and designing/consuming RESTful APIs
- Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud environments
- Understanding of iterative agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, and writing testable, maintainable code
- Consistent access to a private work environment with high speed internet and professionally appropriate surroundings for frequent video conferencing and a workstation setup conducive to remote work needs
- Must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Full Stack Engineer building web and mobile telehealth applications for Bicycle Health’s opioid-use-disorder treatment platform. Developing secure patient-care features across React, Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and cloud services.
Full Stack Engineer building telehealth applications for Bicycle Health’s opioid-use-disorder care platform
Role description:
• Implement, test, and maintain critical product features using TypeScript, React, GraphQL, and Node.js
• Partner with product managers, physicians, and staff members to build solutions that improve the patient experience
• Build and maintain features across mobile applications, TypeScript backend services, and cloud-based data layers
• Ensure end-to-end functionality and performance
• Deliver reliable and transparent value to users while maintaining high standards for code quality and performance
• Embrace Lean Startup behaviors to simplify technology and processes
• Build relationships with teammates and stakeholders
• Participate in code reviews and shared learning sessions
• Maintain regular and predictable attendance
Role requirements:
• 3-5 years of professional experience building and maintaining web or mobile-responsive applications and backend services
• Proficiency with React and Node.js
• Strong experience with TypeScript is highly preferred
• Experience working with GraphQL or Express and designing/consuming RESTful APIs
• Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud environments
• Understanding of iterative agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, and writing testable, maintainable code
• Consistent access to a private work environment with high speed internet and professionally appropriate surroundings for frequent video conferencing and a workstation setup conducive to remote work needs
• Must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis
• Must physically reside within the United States
• No visa sponsorship available now or in the future
Benefits:
• Discretionary PTO + 8.5 days of additional sick time + 10 paid holidays
• Paid parental leave
• 100% Employer Paid Employee Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
• Employer Paid STD & LTD
• 401k
• $50 monthly Remote Work Stipend
• Equity
Tech stack:
Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, GraphQL, JavaScript, Node.js, React, TypeScript
